Bootmii.description:
Install BootMii as IOS (IOS254) from the seed, which holds it when its backup
was taken after the HackMii Installer put BootMii on the console. BootMii
itself runs from the SD card's /bootmii/ folder: add those files under `sd`.
The Homebrew Channel ("Launch BootMii") and Priiloader start it.

Extract.description:
Which archive files go where. Each key is a glob over paths inside the
archive (`*`, `**`, `?`, `[…]`, `{a,b}`); each value a directory. A matching
file loses the folders the glob names before its `**` (or all of them
without one) and keeps the rest: with `"*/data/**": /data/`,
`pkg-1.0/data/x/y` lands at `/data/x/y`. Files no glob matches are left out;
a glob matching nothing, or a file matching two, is an error.

Folder.description:
A glob over the archive's folders (`*`, `**`, `?`, `[…]`, `{a,b}`; `*`
stops at `/`) that must match exactly one, such as `"*/wii/gcmm-dark"`.
That folder's files become apps/<name>/; the rest of the archive is left out.

follow Priiloader's docs/HACKSLIST.md.

Priiloader.description:
Complete Priiloader configuration. Applying it writes every setting and
hack state, replacing what the NAND holds; omitted values use the pinned
0.10.0 defaults.

autoboot.description: Autoboot destination. Defaults to the System Menu.

hacks.description:
Hacks to enable. Every other hack is disabled. The two music hacks, the
two USB Gecko hacks, and the four force_disc_ios hacks exclude each other.

Values:
- fix_480p: Fixes an image display issue of the System Menu in 480p (analog video only).
- block_online_updates: Makes System Menu updates fail (error 32007), to stay on this System Menu.
- block_disc_updates: Skips the "Wii System Update" some game discs force before playing.
- block_disc_autoboot: Stops discs whose ID starts with 0 or 1 (diagnostic discs) from booting automatically.
- auto_press_a: Presses A automatically to get past the health and safety screen.
- remove_deflicker: Disables the System Menu's blur filter; recommended with 480p.
- move_disc_channel: Lets the Disc Channel be moved like any channel (hold A+B).
- remove_nocopy_save_protection: Lets Data Management copy save files that are normally protected from copying to the SD card.
- replace_health_screen: Skips the health warning screen and goes straight to the channels.
- no_background_music: Disables the System Menu's background music.
- wiimmfi: Patches disc games launched from the Disc Channel to use Wiimmfi (not WiiWare).
- region_free_everything: Unblocks region-locked Wii and GameCube discs and channels (WiiWare, VC).
- no_sfx_and_background_music: Disables the System Menu's sound effects and background music.
- re_enable_bannerbomb: Re-enables the Bannerbomb exploit on 4.3.
- usb_gecko_report: Sends the Wii Menu's logs to a USB Gecko in memory card slot B.
- usb_gecko_report_geckoos: Sends the Wii Menu's logs to a USB Gecko in slot B when Gecko OS launched the menu.
- force_data_management: Boots straight into Data Management.
- force_recovery_mode: Starts the console in recovery mode, to launch recovery discs.
- remove_diagnostic_disc_check: In recovery mode, lets any disc boot instead of waiting for the Wii Backup Disc.
- no_delete_homebrew: Prevents the System Menu from deleting the Homebrew Channel, DVDX and others (HAXX, JODI, DVDX, DISC, DISK, RZDx).
- force_disc_ios248: Runs disc games under IOS248, for a cIOS installed there.
- force_disc_ios249: Runs disc games under IOS249 (see force_disc_ios248).
- force_disc_ios250: Runs disc games under IOS250 (see force_disc_ios248).
- force_disc_ios251: Runs disc games under IOS251 (see force_disc_ios248).
- unblock_service_discs: Unblocks service discs: the Wii Startup Disc and the Wii Backup Discs.
- remove_ios16_disc_error: Stops the System Menu from blocking discs that use IOS16 (the Wii Backup Disc).
- mark_network_tested: Marks the network connection as tested, so "Use this connection" works without running the test.

Rvloader.description:
What RVLoader's installer does, done offline: Priiloader starts RVLoader's
bootloader, which loads RVLoader from USB, and the IOS slots 236, 240 and
241 get copies of IOS36 (patched), IOS58 and IOS80 without the stock Wi-Fi
modules. The recipe needs a `priiloader` section without `autoboot` and
`return_to`. The RVLoader release itself goes on the USB drive.

patch_out_wifi.description:
The installer's "Patch out WiFi": IOS36, IOS58 and IOS80 lose their
Wi-Fi modules too. Either way they are reinstalled as the installer does.

vga.description:
The installer's "Enable VGA". Needs `setup.display.progressive`, and
`pal60` for 4.3E. Component video then stops working.

wd_sha256.description:

replacing the stock Wi-Fi modules.
